item.title: Lynn Forbes on How AKA Would’ve Wanted to be Remembered on His 38th Birthday
item.description: Today would have been the 38th birthday of AKA, who passed away on February 10, 2023. Three years after his death, his mother, Lynn Forbes, shared that he would want to be remembered as someone who lived fully and honestly, worked hard, kept growing, loved deeply, and valued his daughter, his loved ones, the Megacy, and his country.
